family.description: This family has been characterised as 3-octaprenyl-4- hydroxybenzoate carboxy-lyase enzymes [[cite:PUB00020511]]. This enzyme catalyses the third reaction in ubiquinone biosynthesis. For optimal activity the carboxy-lase was shown to require Mn2+ [[cite:PUB00020511]]. This entry represents the central RIFT-related domain.
family.name: 3-octaprenyl-4-hydroxybenzoate carboxy-lyase Rift-related domain
